rows.en: But what's the connection between these Vol Cells and that monstrosity that showed up near Mars?

That ship is…

in a word, nothing more than one means of transport used by the Vol Cells that suddenly appeared in outer space…
A means of transport?

Just as a honeybee carries pollen from flower to flower, they rode that ship and came to Earth…

Fifteen years ago, SIDO, before the merger, used that ship to survey a tenth planet that had suddenly appeared in the solar system…

A tenth planet…?

Let's see… Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Pluto, Neptune… Huh, there are only nine?

Come to think of it, more than ten years ago…

I remember the papers saying a new planet had been born in the solar system. So that's this Number Ten?

But three years later, Number Ten suddenly vanished…

As if there had never been anything there to begin with…

And at the very same time, the SIDO ship that had left Earth also lost contact…

Vol Cells!?

You're saying that planet was an intelligent life form made of Vol Cells? And that it used the ship like a taxi?
It's only a hypothesis… but my son believed it without a doubt.

But if that's true…

why? Why didn't the TDF of the time go to rescue the ship?
The TDF left them to die! SIDO's top official, Director Sakomizu, his family, and the entire crew…
That's ridiculous!?

No… it may not be so far-fetched.

After that, the TDF absorbed SIDO and covered up the organization itself… They swept it under the rug!
No way… The TDF would do that?

I'll find out the truth myself!

Oh, it's almost time, isn't it? Kotaro… I'm counting on you to watch the shop!
Yes… International Science Center laboratory.

Dr. Tsuchida, please listen calmly!

That Dr. Dorothy Anderson is an impostor! We just got word from Washington Base… The real Dr. Dorothy Anderson is only leaving now.
What!?
Uwah…

What happened?

Dr. Tsuchida! Dr. Tsuchida!
Captain! A new robot has appeared over the sea near the International Science Center!
What!? A new robot?

Yes… A robot of unknown allegiance!

It doesn't belong to the Iron Mask Party, Brain or BF… none of them!

Uuugh…

And "Dr. Dorothy Anderson" got away too! Damn, is it all over…?

Anyway, let's suspend the defense conference for now…

…!?

What's that…!?
Even Ultraseven's super weapons don't work on it… What a terrifying super robot!
But… what magnificent mechanics!

Dr. Tsuchida! This is no time to be impressed!

"Dr. Dorothy Anderson" was a spy for the Alien Pedan!

What!?

We can't even defeat a single enemy robot! If they attack again, we're helpless!
What's more, they probably know every card we hold.

But, Captain…

Since the conference has been called off, shouldn't the Alien Pedan have no more business with Earth?
What did the Alien Pedan send spies and robots here for in the first place?
The Alien Pedan will keep attacking until they've crushed the Earth completely!
Dan, why is that?
Because the Alien Pedan are convinced that humans will invade their planet someday!
That's a misunderstanding!

That's true…

But there must have been some reason for the Alien Pedan to believe it! Our first priority is to find the cause and clear up the misunderstanding.

Mm…

Dr. Tsuchida… please study a way to beat the enemy! How to defeat that robot… find us a way…

But I can't do it alone…

I absolutely need Dr. Dorothy Anderson's help! I hope she arrives in time… I'll do everything I can.

Ultra Garrison here…

What did you say!?

Captain! That super robot has appeared again.

What!?

Amagi, Soga, Furuhashi, support the Science Patrol and MAT!

Dan! You find the real Dr. Dorothy Anderson! She holds the key to everything…
All riiight… Alien Pedan, I'll teach you a lesson!
As expected of the Alien Pedan. You fooled us completely…

So you were Ultraseven? I had no idea there was an alien in the Ultra Garrison.

Well, Ultraseven… won't you join our side? The Earth will be ours sooner or later. It's for your own good.
I refuse! I work to protect the peace of the Earth.
So as long as the Earth is at peace, other planets can go to ruin?
Earthlings have no intention of invading Planet Pedan! What is it we're supposed to have done?

What you've done?

Didn't you fire a new planet-attack missile at us? Don't you dare say you don't know.
A new planet-attack missile? Earth has no such thing!

Liar…

If the people of the battle fleet nation Naager hadn't shot it down on the way, that missile would have hit Planet Pedan.

The battle fleet nation Naager!?

I see… That missile must have been staged by the Naager themselves! Earth has nothing to do with it!
Is that so? I find that very hard to believe!

There truly are no super weapons for attacking planets on Earth!

The most Earth launches is observation rockets.

Observation? Hmph, how very noble-sounding!

But observation for what? You do it so you can make use of it yourselves someday. I won't fall for that.

That's not it! The true goal of us at the TDF is peace for the entire universe!

We launch observation rockets to understand the universe as a whole! Not to invade it.
You're the only one who thinks that way, Ultraseven.
What!?

Humans are sly, greedy, and thoroughly deceitful!

The proof is that at the Far East Base, they're secretly building weapons to attack the Alien Pedan…
That's… because the Alien Pedan are disturbing the Earth's peace! Look! At that robot…
That's my line! Peeping into other people's homes and throwing stones at them is against the rules!

I see… The Earthlings were certainly in the wrong too.

Let's do this!

If we both stop fighting, neither side has to lose! But if the fighting goes on, one side will be hurt and destroyed…

I want to settle this incident peacefully! The Ultra Garrison will stop researching weapons to fight the Alien Pedan!

In exchange… I want the Alien Pedan to withdraw from Earth!
A promise between aliens?
That's right…

Very well… I'll choose to trust you!

As proof of our sincerity, we'll withdraw King Joe.
What!? You're telling us to stop the research!?
Yes… If we do, the Alien Pedan have sworn they'll withdraw from Earth too.
Dan… You met the Alien Pedan?

Yes!

As a promise between aliens… no, between Earthlings and the Alien Pedan, we discussed it together.
An Earth Defense Conference of just two, an Earthling and an Alien Pedan…
If it's true, that's the best thing that could happen! Peace is what we want, after all.
If those words are true, that is?

What are you doubting!? That super robot, King Joe, withdrew, didn't it!?

The first thing is to trust the other side! Otherwise… humanity will never be able to grasp peace, ever!

…!?

Dr. Dorothy Anderson!
I'm sorry I'm late! I'll help with the research right away…

No, well…

It's just been called off. There's no need anymore.
Captain…
Ms. Anderson… You must be tired. Please, come rest here for a while.
But…

Yes, Ultra Garrison…

What did you say!?

Captain! That super robot has appeared again.
What's going on? Wasn't the super robot supposed to have withdrawn!?
The Alien Pedan's "sincerity" is pretty doubtful, isn't it? Eh? Dan?

uncertain: U10745: the Japanese planet mnemonic 水金地火木土天冥海 (士 for 土) rendered as a list of planet names, in the period order with Pluto before Neptune.
U10753: まんざらでもない read as "it may not be so far-fetched".
U10758-U10759: Tsuchida's line cut by an attack; continuation row is narration-kind.
U10764: 百事体す read as 万事休す "it's all over" (百 for 万 again); "Dr. Dorothy Anderson" in quotes as the impostor.
U10783-U10803: Alien Pedan (the disguised impostor) uses feminine speech; no pronouns needed.
U10799: "Peeping into other people's homes and throwing stones" kept literal.
U10805: 証言 read as 宣言/約束 "have sworn".
omissions_kept: U10759: who cries out is Tsuchida (attacked by the impostor), left as a bare cry.
